suggestions.pitch: At 0-6 I should turn 31-year-old Sutton into the younger, hotter Josh Downs (19.2 a week lately), which a contending partner should like for Sutton's higher projection.
Moves 42-year-old Rodgers and 31-year-old Sutton for 25-year-old Josh Downs, a rebuild-friendly swap at a modest cost in points.
Sends aging Hockenson and Rodgers for 25-year-old Theo Johnson, converting declining value into a younger piece while the season is lost.
